<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="RhV1Ljt5VV1ByqQdVfeP"> <mxGraphModel dx="3394" dy="899" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": " flowchart TB
 REQ[\"One request arrives\"] --> ALG{\"Which algorithm<br/>is configured?\"}

 ALG -->|\"round_robin\"| RR[\"Takes turns<br/>1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3…\"]
 ALG -->|\"least_conn\"| LC[\"Goes to whoever<br/>is least busy right now\"]
 ALG -->|\"ip_hash\"| IH[\"Goes to whoever<br/>your IP maps to\"]

 RR --> RRO[\"Counts stay even.<br/>But slow work hits<br/>every backend equally.\"]
 LC --> LCO[\"Counts get uneven.<br/>But slow work is<br/>sent to fewer backends.\"]
 IH --> IHO[\"<b>All traffic to one backend</b><br/>when clients share an IP (NAT)\"]

 style RR fill:#e8eef7,stroke:#4a6fa5
 style LC fill:#e8f5ec,stroke:#3f8f5a
 style IH fill:#fdd0d0,stroke:#b04a4a
 style IHO fill:#fdd0d0,stroke:#b04a4a,stroke-width:2px",
 "config": null
